adversarial_review.check: The finite Schur solve is attempted only when the residual block is positive; singular/disconnected mutations are rejected.
The block basis uses normalized pi and the same sqrt(pi) transform as the parent rows; invalid weights are rejected.
Core and tail supports are disjoint, in range and large enough for block-mean-zero coordinates.
The coupling correction is subtracted and a claimed combined envelope above the half-minimum is rejected.
The R-422 residual gap is recomputed from an independent basis and compared within the declared tolerance.
The two block modes are retained in this finite assembly but no common-core or limit statement is asserted.
Finite positive Schur values do not establish regulator uniformity, history transfer, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction or a physical conclusion.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite two-block harmonic coarse-Schur assembly only. It does not close any uniform, common-core, sector, continuum or physical gate.
decision_reason: The exact finite harmonic Schur decomposition retains the block-constant sector and agrees with an independent residual recomputation on all eligible fixed-grid rows. The result is a finite interface and does not supply the uniform analytic estimates required by the parent Q3LOCK gates.
decision_scope: Finite two-block harmonic coarse-Schur assembly on the fixed R-422 Q3 grid; no tier change.
finding: The primary lane passes 1471/1471 assertions over 858 conditional rows, 282 rows with a nonempty tail and 114 eligible rows; every eligible row has a positive coarse Schur gap, residual gap and combined half-minimum envelope. Coarse gaps range from 9.416287072814253 to 900.9775546526778, residual gaps from 2.0659023307146094 to 7.874609499214968, and combined envelopes from 1.0329511653573047 to 3.937304749607484. The maximum residual reuse difference is 9.393117395006811e-10. Independent 27/27, hostile 7/7, integrated 22/22 and Lean R424 pass.

formal_integration.lean: R424 PASS; scalar harmonic split and lower-envelope algebra only

method: Reuse the hash-pinned R-419 conditional law, projected conductance, R-421 tail interface and R-422 residual split without retuning.
For every eligible row construct the weighted two-block span and its orthogonal residual complement after the sqrt(pi) transform.
Compute the harmonic Schur coarse gap and residual gap, then record 0.5*min(coarse,residual) as the finite combined lower envelope.
Recompute the residual gap with an independent block-mean-zero basis and compare within 5e-7.
Run independent reversible fixtures, reject seven hostile mutations, compile the scalar Lean cross-check, and preserve the finite-only boundary.
next_action: Derive a domain-controlled analytic coarse-capacity and residual-boundary estimate on one common core, then transfer it through the R-399/R-415 history and OS/KMS/GNS interfaces.
no_overclaim: Finite positive coarse and residual values are a matrix-level certificate on the declared grid. They do not prove a uniform sector gap, a continuum result, a Yang-Mills statement or a mass gap.
question: Does retaining the two block-constant modes and eliminating the R-422 residual by harmonic extension yield a positive finite coarse Schur and combined lower envelope on the fixed Q3 grid?
title: Finite two-block harmonic coarse Schur assembly
